import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

LATE_WINDOW_H = 36


def drop_late_duplicates(df: pd.DataFrame, run_date: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df["issued_at"] = pd.to_datetime(df["issued_at"])
    cutoff = datetime.fromisoformat(run_date).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=LATE_WINDOW_H)
    df = df.sort_values(["invoice_id", "issued_at"])
    # keep the latest revision per invoice
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["invoice_id"], keep="last")
    mask = df["issued_at"] < cutoff
    return df[~mask | df["is_final"]]
